worldcombat.skill.bitterblade.summary: Sweeps a fiery arc of regret through everything in front, hitting every enemy in it and siphoning the wounds back; the more health the user has lost, the heavier the cut.
worldcombat.skill.bitterblade.descriptio: The slash deals about %1$s contact damage to every enemy caught in the arc; the more health the user has lost, the deeper the cut. The target's defence, type and crits are applied on the hit.
The arc opens %1$s degrees and reaches %2$s blocks (also the real range), with a %3$s block blade height.
%1$s of the damage dealt is restored to the user, and more while wounded.
worldcombat.skill.bitterblade.sweep.on: Sweep: a wider, longer arc that catches everything in front, but each target is hit lighter, siphons less and recovery is slower.
worldcombat.skill.bitterblade.sweep.off: Straight cut: a narrow, deep arc that hits one target harder, siphons more and comes out faster.
worldcombat.skill.bitterblade.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %5$s PP, cooldown %4$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.bitterblade.growth.0: From level %1$s the slash power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.bitterblade.growth.1: From level %1$s the slash power rises to %2$s and the drain share to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.bitterblade.use.0: Sweep a crowded front line clear
worldcombat.skill.bitterblade.use.1: Turn bitter regret into a heavier cut and healing while wounded
worldcombat.skill.bitterblade.use.2: Press several targets at once with one fiery arc
worldcombat.skill.bitterblade.preference: On: a wider, longer arc that catches everything in front, but each target is hit lighter, siphons less and recovery is slower. Off: a narrow, deep cut with more power, more drain and a faster start.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger strikes from further out.
On: ranks bitter blade high when two or more foes stand within reach, as a clear-out tool. Off: treated as an ordinary melee attack.
Below this health ratio regret deepens the cut and the move is ranked higher; higher starts using it as a counter-attack sooner.
